blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI applied to Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Automotive and discrete plants chase three numbers — OEE, escapes and launch time. Sensor network, vision inspection and scheduling intelligence move all three simultaneously, while IATF traceability and IT/OT security raise the baseline every program must respect.

items: Defect detection by eyes/sampling; escapes reach customers and recalls cost millions.
Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components and energy per unit are estimates.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems, Conversational AI & Digital Humans, Generative AI Platform Engineering from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Line changeover sequencing, Vision inspection, Predictive maintenance) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — IATF 16949 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Own your models: tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.
Answers with citations, not vibes: permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate.
Models that read scans, scenes and schematics: multimodal intelligence wired into operations.
Defect detection closed into andon/MES holds (escapes down sharply)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Manufacturing & Industrial level this capability reads as: multivariate telemetry models flagging drift before scrap is produced (scrap and rework cost down 15-25%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
